name: java-guardrails
description: Deterministic quality gates for brownfield Java code bases, installed one gate at a time by an agent that refactors until the build is green.

plugins.name: java-guardrails
plugins.description: PMD, SpotBugs, Error Prone, ArchUnit, JaCoCo, NullAway, Lincheck and PIT gates with calibrated settings, playbooks and Java scripts run through a bundled JBang wrapper.
